summary: 已修复 25 版 LAN 单地址列表误拦，保留旧版写入流程。已完成三轮核对，399 项定向回归通过。
scope: All Common Settings cards and initialization sub-options; source/contract/offline review, not live-device certification

diagnostic_evidence.connection: snapshot commands completed successfully before the local planner rejected the input
diagnostic_evidence.limit: Export omits raw network.lan. The exact failed-device ipaddr/gateway cannot be reconstructed. The single-address-list defect is confirmed independently against official 25.12.6 config_generate bytes and reproduced in real Lua fixtures.

changes.effect: Allow one valid IPv4 address in a list; retain multi-address, gateway, DHCP-pool and upstream-conflict guards. Do not branch on firmware versions. Existing scalar target plus netmask write contract is unchanged.

Compare runtime IPv4 addresses against scalar or list CIDR saved addresses, including restoring the original 25.12 list. Saved values must still match exactly; Python network_ready verifies the prefix and device.
Eight focused regressions covering scalar/list formats, real Lua persistence, invalid data, conflict protection, full initial plan, editor save and verified rollback to CIDR lists.

rounds.method: Trace forward from card actions and read paths; compare exact default configuration and component fields
rounds.sources: 50 config_generate source files rehashed against exact release records; official v25.12.6 system, dropbear, uhttpd, sysntpd, dnsmasq and firewall sources read through web
rounds.finding: Confirmed single-element list misclassified as multi-address. No additional confirmed read/field defect in reviewed common settings.

rounds.method: Trace save/apply/confirmation and reverse recovery paths; compare native rpcd semantics
rounds.sources: 50 exact-release rpcd Makefile-to-commit mappings and uci.c hashes revalidated; apply, confirm, rollback and config.change implementations inspected
rounds.finding: Confirmed original list/CIDR runtime equality failed during policy restore verification; fixed together with the planner. Existing general LAN editor already supports CIDR lists and rollback.

rounds.method: Cross-check exact 25.12.6 service/package changes against unchanged old paths; inject failures and run all selected regressions once together
rounds.sources: Official sysupgrade/firstboot, LuCI static protocol and dispatcher, fstools pinned block.c, BusyBox 1.37.0 source archive verified against the exact OpenWrt SHA256
rounds.finding: factoryreset, apk backup metadata and generated service-state archive member already handled. No additional confirmed defect within this review scope. No unrelated implementation changes made.

feature_review.result: Fixed initialization list rejection and original-format restore verification; old scalar/mask, legacy ifname/type and modern device bindings covered
BusyBox 1.37.0 prompts and stdin path match bounded implementation; fingerprint-pinned independent authentication and secret cleanup retained
25.12.6 service option names, /tmp/TZ versus zoneinfo symlink and reload contract match existing implementation

feature_review.feature: Initialization firewall, SSH and HTTP options
feature_review.result: DirectInterface precedence already cleared, LAN logical binding retained; selected upstream zones, echo-only IPv6 drops and separate listen_http/listen_https handling retained

Capability-gated translation and actual LuCI page probes retained; unique active /www server and custom index order guards retained; LuCI sources reviewed from 25.12 branch, not claimed as exact installed package bytes

feature_review.feature: Boot Wi-Fi policy and station/AP identity
feature_review.result: START=18 before network START=20, saved enable switches, credentials and actual radio ownership protections retained
Pinned fstools anon_swap and auto_mount semantics match; existing configured swap preserved; attended service path capability-gated

Native sysupgrade owns opkg/apk metadata; etc/uci-defaults service-state archive member accepted; factoryreset/jffs2reset selected by capability and layout, original fingerprint/backup/confirmation protections retained
LAN protected; exact selected sections/interfaces, live references and active-task ownership rechecked; existing tests pass

verification.runtime: Windows project .venv; real Lua interpreter plus simulated UCI/rpcd and Qt tests
verification.syntax: py_compile passed for both changed implementation files and new regression file
verification.encoding: UTF-8 strict decode and replacement/mojibake scan passed
verification.fault_injection_output: Expected monitor permission-denied fault logged by a passing cleanup regression; suite outcome OK

limits: No router or local adapter configuration was changed; no package built or published.
Raw failed-device LAN configuration was not included in user export; a real gateway or customized multi-address configuration must still be inspected before changing it.
Windows offline execution does not establish Debian 12 native acceptance; shared Python/Lua code contains no new OS-specific branch.
No all-hardware/all-release runtime certification is claimed. Parser change is hardware-independent; reset/storage/radio behavior remains device-specific.
Browser evidence files hash the extracted evidence record, not upstream raw bytes. Exact local source and BusyBox member hashes are separately identified.
Native router acceptance remains: preview initialization on 25.12.6 and an old firmware, apply only after user confirmation and backup, verify saved/runtime address, then test controlled recovery.
